verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API supports custom receipt text (disclaimers, promotional messages, thank-you notes) and Terminal API supports tip/signature capture at checkout, implying receipt issuance is native to the platform, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of an email/SMS receipt delivery API or details on card-network compliance requirements for receipts. missing for 10: dedicated Receipts API/email-SMS delivery docs, explicit card-network compliance mention, independent verification of receipt issuance flow.
